blocks.text: Computational thinking sochne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis se masle saaf aur mantiqi tareeqe se hal kiye jate hain. Yeh bare masle ko chhote aur aasan hisson mein torne mein madad deta hai. Yeh soch sirf computer science ke students ke liye nahi, sab ke kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Scientists, engineers, balkay chefs (bawarchi) bhi mushkil kaamon ki planning karte waqt computational thinking istemal karte hain.
